color_evidence.basis: Estimated from the independently saved archive front image; not official HEX.

observations: White with a fine broken, wavy herringbone-like field of blue-grey and pale cyan vertical lines across body and sleeves; plain white ring. The finest two print colors are reduced to one muted ink while keeping the observed fragmented forms. Discrete constant-color contours from branding-free crop [386,825,560,580], 360px sampling, 100 × 103.6 unit reflected repetition; hidden print placement is adapted, and source fabric pixels are not embedded. All palette values are visual estimates. Paint adapts the observed color layout to the unchanged original PNG; no second physical collar is drawn.
omitted: Emblems, logos, sponsors and lettering. Original PNG collar construction retained.
